method: Referenced ImageGen edit. The selected PNG is the original returned file.
request:
Edit the first input image, the selected storyboard. Preserve the existing four landscape panel positions in a 2×2 grid, exact original numbered SHOT_ badges, original palette/compositions and actor likeness. The second input is original family visual reference. Dan blue / left watch, Maya plum with ponytail, Nina teal auburn waves, Leo orange, braided Ella in denim overalls, small Max green. A third reference supplies setting or continuity. In every panel actors and props must follow its specified shot precisely. Keep good panels intact. Apply the following specific changes in the artwork. Third reference combines the actual restaurant, seating chart and printed menu. One rectangle, six chairs in two groups of three along long sides, empty table heads. Near-to-far (from camera) down left AISLE side are Dan, Leo, Ella. Opposite them down right WINDOW side are Max, Nina, Maya. 017 ALL THREE Dan, Leo, Ella sit on SAME left long side, Leo in the middle, all pointing across in same direction in three-quarter view with Dan nearest. Leo separates menu sections. 018 Ella on aisle side faces Maya DIRECTLY ACROSS the far end, with Nina beside Maya. On menu, vegetable pasta $12. 019 Max and Nina side-by-side on window side are opposite Dan; Nina chooses grilled chicken with rice $14. 020 Leo and Dan on SAME aisle side while Maya sits diagonally ACROSS, Leo points to cheese sandwich $8. Choose profile or over-the-shoulder shots, keep camera at empty short end to show which side is which. Six place settings, no meals served, keep the cast subsets; no seat chart in actual panels.
SHOT_017 shows only LEO, ELLA, DAN in RESTAURANT_TABLE. Leo separates the appetizer, main-course and dessert sections. Ella says she wants a main course; Dan decides they do not need an appetizer while choosing six dinners. End: Appetizers declined; choices will be six main courses only. Existing artwork error: Leo points at bare ruled pages while Ella and Dan sit opposite him instead of on his aisle side. Fix: Restore agreed chairs and exact menu sections.
SHOT_018 shows only MAYA, ELLA, NINA in RESTAURANT_TABLE. Maya selects the twelve-dollar vegetable pasta after reading its ingredients. Ella notices the visible vegetable description; Nina leaves space for Maya's choice rather than ordering for her. End: Maya's choice recorded mentally as vegetable pasta $12; no plate served. Existing artwork error: Ella sits alongside Maya and Nina on window side; all three face camera across long side. Fix: Return Ella to far aisle opposite Maya.
SHOT_019 shows only NINA, MAX, DAN in RESTAURANT_TABLE. Nina chooses grilled chicken with rice for fourteen dollars. Dan checks that it is one main course including rice, not two separate orders. End: Nina selects one chicken-and-rice main $14; rice included in that price. Existing artwork error: Dan, Max and Nina sit in row along one table side with empty plates. Fix: Return Dan opposite Max rather than on his side.
SHOT_020 shows only LEO, MAYA, DAN in RESTAURANT_TABLE. Leo chooses the eight-dollar cheese sandwich. Maya confirms he may order for himself. Dan quietly adds eight to the two adult choices without handing over money. End: Leo selects cheese sandwich $8; running food choices total $34. Existing artwork error: Leo, Maya and Dan read blank menu, with Maya adjacent to Dan at same table side. Fix: Seat Maya window-far and use exact menu artwork.

SHOT_017.observed: Dan, Leo and Ella sit in near-to-far order at the aisle side, with Leo pointing to the three menu sections. The opposite unoccupied chairs are in view.
SHOT_017.correction: Tighten the profile framing so the other three family members’ occupied window-side seats remain outside the shot.

SHOT_018.observed: Ella faces the adults, and the menu highlights vegetable pasta at $12. Maya sits at what reads as the far head of the table rather than along the window edge.
SHOT_018.correction: Seat Maya directly across from Ella on the far window side, next to Nina. Keep both short ends clear.

SHOT_019.observed: Dan and Nina flank Max, who appears at the short end. The menu correctly lists adult grilled chicken and rice at $14.
SHOT_019.correction: Place Max at the near window-side long edge facing Dan, with Nina in the next chair farther down the same edge.

SHOT_020.observed: Leo and Dan are on the same side with Maya across and the cheese sandwich marked $8. Leo is nearer the empty short end than Dan.
SHOT_020.correction: Reverse Dan and Leo’s depth order on the aisle side: Dan nearest, Leo middle. Keep Maya at the far window seat.
